answers.core: It's not possible for this to be an add-on / even as an addon it could easily result in mass data loss.
answers.workaround: When renaming a property, you can manually edit every `tscn`/`tres` file that has your script, or turn your script into a tool script and use a setter/getter to transfer the data over, but both of these are highly inconvenient and don't scale well.

title: Store script property names as case insensitive
